prompt.zh-CN: 用两三句话回答下面的问题。
prompt.en-US: Answer the question below in two or three sentences.

question.zh-CN: 为什么 TTL 类题目的测试推进假时钟，而不是调用 `time.sleep(ttl)`？
question.en-US: Why do tests for TTL problems advance a fake clock instead of calling `time.sleep(ttl)`?

description.zh-CN: 指出真实睡眠受调度抖动影响，边界（恰好 ttl）无法稳定命中
description.en-US: Says real sleeping jitters, so the exact-ttl boundary cannot be hit reliably

description.zh-CN: 指出测试不必真的等待，几十个用例也能毫秒级跑完
description.en-US: Says tests need not actually wait, so dozens of cases still run in milliseconds

description.zh-CN: 提到可以精确构造 `now == expires_at` 这一边界

modelAnswer.zh-CN: 真实睡眠既慢又不确定：调度抖动让“恰好 ttl 秒”这种边界无法稳定复现。假时钟让测试把时间精确推进到 `expires_at`，零等待、可重复，边界条件一测一个准。
modelAnswer.en-US: Real sleeps are slow and nondeterministic: scheduler jitter makes an exact-ttl boundary impossible to reproduce. A fake clock lets the test move time to exactly `expires_at` with zero waiting and full repeatability.

explanation.zh-CN: 这就是本题库所有时间类题目都用 `dojo.clock` 的原因：确定、快速、能精确卡边界。
explanation.en-US: That is why every time-based item in this bank uses `dojo.clock`: deterministic, fast, and exact at the boundary.
